programs.title: Tum Haseen Main Jawan
programs.desc: A navy officer who has had a number of affairs with attractive young women meets a beautiful girl and falls in love. Though she loves him in return, another admirer of hers tells the officer that she is deceiving him and is the mother of a child.

programs.title: New Delhi
programs.desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.

programs.title: Tawaif
programs.desc: Due to unforeseen circumstances, Dawood accepts Sultana, a courtesan, as his wife in spite of being in love with author Kaynat. His life soon changes when he finds himself falling for Sultana.

programs.title: Andar Bahar
programs.desc: A Police Inspector, Ravi, has been assigned the task of apprehending notorious gangster, Shera, who, however, proves to be too elusive for him. Ravi then seeks the assistance of another gangster, Raja, who is doing time in prison. Released in the custody of Ravi, who doesn't know that Raja has his own agenda behind this so-called co-operation.
